prompt: The attached image is a 240x242 px frame from an animated GIF. Rebuild the scene in 3D with three.js. Task (3D, static): write an HTML page that builds the scene from code and renders it so that the view from your reference camera reproduces the image as faithfully as you can: characters, poses, facial expressions, hands, props, background, and colors. A later step will animate your scene, so structure it in named groups. For this static step, render(t) may ignore t. three.js contract: - The harness injects an import map for three.js r187. Import from 'three' and from 'three/addons/'; the only addons available are 'three/addons/controls/OrbitControls.js', 'three/addons/geometries/ConvexGeometry.js', 'three/addons/geometries/ParametricFunctions.js', 'three/addons/geometries/ParametricGeometry.js', 'three/addons/geometries/RoundedBoxGeometry.js', 'three/addons/math/ConvexHull.js', 'three/addons/utils/BufferGeometryUtils.js'. Use one

<!DOCTYPE html>

<script type="module">
import * as THREE from 'three';
import { RoundedBoxGeometry } from 'three/addons/geometries/RoundedBoxGeometry.js';

const scene = new THREE.Scene();
scene.background = new THREE.Color(0xae9e8b);
const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({preserveDrawingBuffer:true, antialias:true});
renderer.setPixelRatio(1);
renderer.setSize(240,242);
renderer.outputColorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
renderer.shadowMap.enabled = true;
renderer.shadowMap.type = THREE.PCFShadowMap;
document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

const sin = 0.397, cos = Math.sqrt(1-sin*sin);
const X = new THREE.Vector3(1,0,0);
const U = new THREE.Vector3(0,cos,-sin);
const D = new THREE.Vector3(0,sin,cos);
const ref = new THREE.OrthographicCamera(-120,120,121,-121,1,1200);
ref.position.copy(D).multiplyScalar(530);
ref.lookAt(0,0,0);

function p(x,y,d=0) {
  return new THREE.Vector3(x-120,0,0).addScaledVector(U,121-y).addScaledVector(D,d);
}
function group(name,parent=scene) {
  const g = new THREE.Group();
  g.name = name;
  parent.add(g);
  return g;
}
function material(color, roughness=.83, extra={}) {
  return new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color,roughness,...extra});
}
function mesh(parent,name,geometry,mat,shadow=true) {
  const m = new THREE.Mesh(geometry,mat);
  m.name = name;
  m.castShadow = shadow;
  m.receiveShadow = true;
  parent.add(m);
  return m;
}
const sphere = new THREE.SphereGeometry(1,36,24);
function ell(parent,name,x,y,d,a,b,c,mat,roll=0) {
  const m = mesh(parent,name,sphere,mat);
  m.position.copy(p(x,y,d));
  m.quaternion.setFromRotationMatrix(new THREE.Matrix4().makeBasis(X,U,D));
  m.rotateZ(roll);
  m.scale.set(a,b,c);
  return m;
}
function box(parent,name,x,y,z,w,h,l,mat,r=0) {
  const m = mesh(parent,name,r ? new RoundedBoxGeometry(w,h,l,3,r) : new THREE.BoxGeometry(w,h,l),mat);
  m.position.set(x,y,z);
  return m;
}
function grid(rows,cols,point,colorAt,reverse=false) {
  const xyz=[],rgb=[],idx=[];
  for(let i=0;i<=rows;i++) {
    for(let j=0;j<=cols;j++) {
      const v=i/rows,u=j/cols, q=point(u,v);
      xyz.push(q.x,q.y,q.z);
      if(colorAt) {
        const c=colorAt(u,v,q);
        rgb.push(c.r,c.g,c.b);
      }
      if(i<rows && j<cols) {
        const a=i*(cols+1)+j,b=a+cols+1;
        if(reverse) idx.push(a,a+1,b,a+1,b+1,b);
        else idx.push(a,b,a+1,a+1,b,b+1);
      }
    }
  }
  const geo=new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  geo.setAttribute('position',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(xyz,3));
  if(colorAt) geo.setAttribute('color',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(rgb,3));
  geo.setIndex(idx);
  geo.computeVertexNormals();
  return geo;
}
function sweep(parent,name,knots,mat) {
  const path=new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(knots.map(k=>p(...k.slice(0,3))));
  const section=new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(knots.map(k=>new THREE.Vector3(k[3],k[4]??k[3],0)));
  const geo=grid(48,24,(u,v)=>{
    const q=path.getPoint(v), t=path.getTangent(v);
    const a=new THREE.Vector3().crossVectors(D,t);
    if(a.lengthSq()<.001) a.crossVectors(U,t);
    a.normalize();
    const b=new THREE.Vector3().crossVectors(t,a);
    const r=section.getPoint(v), angle=u*Math.PI*2;
    return q.addScaledVector(a,Math.cos(angle)*Math.max(.025,r.x))
      .addScaledVector(b,Math.sin(angle)*Math.max(.025,r.y));
  });
  return mesh(parent,name,geo,mat);
}
function stroke(parent,name,points,r,mat,shadow=false) {
  const path=new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(points.map(k=>Array.isArray(k)?p(...k):k));
  return mesh(parent,name,new THREE.TubeGeometry(path,Math.max(10,points.length*4),r,9,false),mat,shadow);
}
function segment(parent,name,a,b,r1,r2,mat) {
  const from=Array.isArray(a)?p(...a):a, to=Array.isArray(b)?p(...b):b;
  const delta=to.clone().sub(from);
  const m=mesh(parent,name,new THREE.CylinderGeometry(r2,r1,delta.length(),16),mat);
  m.position.copy(from).lerp(to,.5);
  m.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(new THREE.Vector3(0,1,0),delta.normalize());
  return m;
}

function onDesk(x,y,h=0) {

  seed=(Math.imul(seed,1664525)+1013904223)>>>0;
  return seed/4294967296;

  const points=[new THREE.Vector3(x,deskY+.04,z),new THREE.Vector3(x+len*.5,deskY+.04,z+(random()-.5)*1.2),new THREE.Vector3(x+len,deskY+.04,z+.45)];

const skinL=material(0xf2ae24,.87);

function body(parent,profile,gold,bib,bibX,bibY,bibW,bibH) {
  const centers=new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(profile.map(k=>new THREE.Vector3(k[0],k[1],k[2])));
  const radii=new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(profile.map(k=>new THREE.Vector3(k[3],k[4],0)));
  function at(u,v) {
    const c=centers.getPoint(v),r=radii.getPoint(v),a=u*2*Math.PI;
    return p(c.x+Math.sin(a)*Math.max(.08,r.x),c.y,c.z+Math.cos(a)*Math.max(.08,r.y));
  }
  const yellow=new THREE.Color(gold),cream=new THREE.Color(bib);
  const geo=grid(112,120,at,(u,v,q)=>{
    const xx=q.x+120, yy=121-q.dot(U);
    const cV=Math.cos(u*2*Math.PI);
    const oval=Math.hypot((xx-bibX)/bibW,(yy-bibY)/bibH);
    const edge=.025*Math.sin(xx*.23+yy*.17)+.015*Math.cos(yy*.47);
    const blend=THREE.MathUtils.smoothstep(1-oval+edge,-.09,.09)*THREE.MathUtils.smoothstep(cV,.27,.64);
    const n=1+.026*Math.sin(xx*.71+yy*.82)*Math.cos(q.z*.48+xx*.12)
      +.018*Math.cos(xx*.23-yy*.32+q.z*.4);
    return yellow.clone().lerp(cream,blend).multiplyScalar(n);
  });
  const normals=geo.attributes.normal;
  for(let i=0;i<=112;i++) {
    const a=i*121,b=a+120;
    const n=new THREE.Vector3(normals.getX(a)+normals.getX(b),normals.getY(a)+normals.getY(b),normals.getZ(a)+normals.getZ(b)).normalize();
    normals.setXYZ(a,n.x,n.y,n.z);
    normals.setXYZ(b,n.x,n.y,n.z);
  }
  mesh(parent,'continuous head and body',geo,bodyMaterial);
}
function eye(parent,name,x,y,d,size,lookX,lookY,tilt) {
  const g=group(name,parent);
  ell(g,'gold eyelid',x,y,d,size*1.09,size*1.18,size*.48,eyeSocket,tilt);
  ell(g,'charcoal gray eye',x,y,d+1.9,size,size*1.07,size*.59,eyeGray,tilt);
  ell(g,'black pupil',x+lookX,y+lookY,d+size*.57+2,size*.59,size*.68,size*.27,eyeDark,tilt);
  ell(g,'eye glint',x+lookX-size*.22,y+lookY-size*.29,d+size*.78+2,size*.12,size*.12,size*.06,glint);
}
const left=group('character-left-writing');

  [65,51,-3,.1,.1],[65,54,-3,15,13],[63,63,-3,26,23],

  [52,130,3,48,38],[47,153,5,52,43],[49,180,4,54,46],
  [57,199,1,49,39],[59,212,-1,21,21],[59,215,-1,.1,.1]
],0xf3af27,0xeac98d,56,177,45,36);

const props=group('desk props');
const paper=material(0xf3e5cc,.94,{side:THREE.DoubleSide,vertexColors:true});
const pageEdge=material(0xc9b897,.94,{side:THREE.DoubleSide});
const mainCover=material(0x635549,.88,{side:THREE.DoubleSide});
const spareCover=material(0xbfa580,.9,{side:THREE.DoubleSide});
const gutter=material(0x82715a,.89);
function book(name,quadLeft,quadRight,cover,thickness,arch) {
  const g=group(name,props);
  function pagePoint(quad,side,u,v,layer=1) {
    const x=THREE.MathUtils.lerp(THREE.MathUtils.lerp(quad[0][0],quad[1][0],u),THREE.MathUtils.lerp(quad[2][0],quad[3][0],u),v);
    const y=THREE.MathUtils.lerp(THREE.MathUtils.lerp(quad[0][1],quad[1][1],u),THREE.MathUtils.lerp(quad[2][1],quad[3][1],u),v);
    const fromSpine=side===0?1-u:u;
    const shape=Math.sin(Math.PI*Math.pow(fromSpine,.75))*(.85+.15*Math.sin(v*Math.PI));
    const base=onDesk(x,y,0);
    base.y+=.5+layer*(thickness+arch*shape+.7*fromSpine);
    return base;
  }
  [quadLeft,quadRight].forEach((quad,side)=>{
    mesh(g,'cloth cover '+side,grid(2,4,(u,v)=>{
      const pt=pagePoint(quad,side,u,v,0);
      pt.x+=(u-.5)*3;
      pt.z+=(v-.5)*4;
      return pt;
    }),cover);
    mesh(g,'paper surface '+side,grid(20,30,(u,v)=>pagePoint(quad,side,u,v),u=>{
      const t=side===0?1-u:u;
      return new THREE.Color(0xffffff).multiplyScalar(.68+.32*THREE.MathUtils.smoothstep(t,0,.18));
    },true),paper);
    for(const edge of [0,1,2,3]) {
      const sample=(s,h)=>edge<2?pagePoint(quad,side,s,edge,h):pagePoint(quad,side,edge-2,s,h);
      mesh(g,'page block edge',grid(2,25,(u,v)=>sample(u,v)),pageEdge);
      for(let k=1;k<=4;k++) {
        const line=[];
        for(let j=0;j<=10;j++) line.push(sample(j/10,k/5));
        stroke(g,'individual sheet edge',line,.12,k%2?pageEdge:gutter);
      }
    }
  });
  const crease=[];
  for(let j=0;j<=10;j++) {
    const q=pagePoint(quadLeft,0,1,j/10);
    q.y+=.16;
    crease.push(q);
  }
  stroke(g,'center binding',crease,.47,gutter);
}
book('open notebook under pencil',

segment(pencil,'light reflecting on barrel',pencilEnd.clone().add(new THREE.Vector3(.64,.5,.48)),along(pencilEnd,pencilTip,.85).add(new THREE.Vector3(.64,.5,.48)),.23,.24,metal);

function loosePencil(name,x1,y1,x2,y2,barrel,r) {
  const g=group(name,props);
  const a=onDesk(x1,y1,r),b=onDesk(x2,y2,r);
  segment(g,'painted barrel',along(a,b,.13),along(a,b,.91),r,r,barrel);
  segment(g,'sharpened wood',along(a,b,.13),along(a,b,.022),r,.33,pencilWood);
  segment(g,'lead',along(a,b,.022),a,.33,.06,graphite);
  segment(g,'end cap',along(a,b,.91),b,r,r,metal);
}
loosePencil('brown pencil at right',174,208,225,223,pencilDark,1.15);
loosePencil('ochre pencil at right',185,218,232,230,pencilGold,1.45);
